name: uchiyomi-suwayomi
description: The extension engine for Uchiyomi: it runs Mihon/Tachiyomi extensions so Uchiyomi can search, follow and download from them. You never open it yourself; Uchiyomi's Admin, Sources tab is where you add repositories and install extensions. Install Uchiyomi first. Choose a password for the engine below (AUTH_PASSWORD): its port is on your network, so it asks for one. Before the first start, open the Unraid terminal and run: mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/uchiyomi-suwayomi and then chown 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/uchiyomi-suwayomi (the engine runs as user 1000 and cannot write to a folder that belongs to root). It takes a minute or two to start the first time. Then, on the uchiyomi container, set SUWAYOMI_URL to http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:4567, SUWAYOMI_USERNAME to the user name below (uchiyomi unless you changed it) and SUWAYOMI_PASSWORD to the password you chose, and apply. It uses 1 to 1.5 GB of memory while it runs and is capped at 2 GB. MangaDex and sites you add by address work in Uchiyomi without it. To remove it, stop it and clear SUWAYOMI_URL on Uchiyomi; keep its appdata folder if you might come back, because it holds the links for every series you added through an extension.

paths.name: Engine data
paths.description: Installed extensions, and the links for every series added through them. Never delete it. It is not in Uchiyomi's nightly backup: back it up with your appdata. Must belong to user 1000 (see the overview).

ports.name: API port
ports.description: The port Uchiyomi talks to: SUWAYOMI_URL is http://YOUR-SERVER-IP:4567. Its own web page is off, and the user name and password below guard it.

variables.name: FLARESOLVERR_URL
variables.description: The same FlareSolverr address as Uchiyomi's FLARESOLVERR_URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8191. Without it, extension sources behind Cloudflare fail with Cloudflare bypass currently disabled.

variables.name: FLARESOLVERR_ENABLED
variables.description: Let the engine use that FlareSolverr. It has no browser of its own.

variables.name: JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS
variables.description: The engine's heap cap, the same as the desktop app's. Raise it only if the engine's log says java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space, and raise the memory limit in Extra Parameters by the same amount: keep that limit at least 1.25 GB above this.

variables.name: MALLOC_ARENA_MAX
variables.description: Keep 2. The C library otherwise gives the engine up to eight memory pools per CPU core, and what one thread frees stays in its own pool: with 2 the engine holds about 120 MB less.

variables.name: AUTO_DOWNLOAD_CHAPTERS
variables.description: Keep false: Uchiyomi does the downloading and owns the library. True would fill this folder with a second, unmanaged copy.

variables.name: WEB_UI_ENABLED
variables.description: The engine's own web page. Off: Uchiyomi is the interface.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Time zone for the engine's logs.

variables.name: AUTH_MODE
variables.description: basic_auth: the engine's port asks for the user name and password below, which Uchiyomi sends as SUWAYOMI_USERNAME and SUWAYOMI_PASSWORD. Leave it on: the port is on your network.

variables.name: AUTH_USERNAME
variables.description: The engine's user name. Set the same on the uchiyomi container as SUWAYOMI_USERNAME.

variables.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Choose a password for the engine, and set the same on the uchiyomi container as SUWAYOMI_PASSWORD.
